title: Design: No Charge category helper says it shows on the work order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Start on Administration > Service > Internal Work Orders, No Charge categories tab.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow0-06-2c-new-no-charge-category.png, iwo-happy-06-06-new-no-charge-category.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Under Name the helper reads "Shown in the Category select when a work order is marked No Charge. It shows on the work order, the NO CHARGE document and the Internal Work Orders report." (the design version).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories), story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R16: “It is not shown on the work order detail or in lists; the badge is the only mark there.”
  • S2-R1: “There is no checkbox to tick and no category to pick on the work order.”
